enriched_activities.desc: Lie on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Breathe deeply. Turn to left side. Bend knees. Place arm under pillow. Turn to back. Stretch arms. Turn to right side. Pull blanket up. Remain still. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Breathe slowly. Stay in bed.

Wake up. Sit up on bed. Swing legs over edge. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wash face with water. Pick up towel. Dry face. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out milk and eggs. Close refrigerator. Place milk and eggs on counter. Open cabinet. Take out bowl and pan. Crack eggs into bowl. Whisk eggs with fork. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Pour eggs into pan. Cook eggs. Turn off stove. Place eggs on plate. Pour milk into glass. Sit at table. Eat breakfast. Drink milk. Stand up. Carry plate and glass to sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and packing bag for work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out shirt and pants. Close wardrobe. Take off pajamas. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Open drawer. Take out bag. Open bag. Pack laptop. Pack notebook. Pack pen. Zip bag. Pick up phone. Put phone in pocket. Pick up bag. Walk out of bedroom.

Walk out of house. Lock door. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Get off bus. Walk to office building. Enter building. Walk to elevator. Press button. Wait for elevator. Enter elevator. Press floor button. Exit elevator. Walk to office. Open office door. Enter office.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as community program coordinator (planning, meetings)
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Enter password. Open email. Read emails. Reply to emails. Open calendar. Pick up phone. Call colleague. Hang up. Open document. Type notes. Attend meeting. Walk to meeting room. Sit at table. Open notebook. Take notes. Say 'Good morning everyone.' Discuss agenda. Walk back to desk.

Walk to cafeteria. Pick up tray. Choose sandwich. Choose fruit. Pay for food. Carry tray to table. Sit down. Eat sandwich. Eat fruit. Drink water. Talk to coworker. Say 'How's your day?' Listen to response. Clear tray. Throw trash in bin. Walk back to office.

enriched_activities.activity: Continuing work as community program coordinator
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Open computer. Work on report. Type on keyboard. Make phone call. Speak to partner organization. Take notes. Attend another meeting. Walk to meeting room. Sit at table. Discuss project timeline. Agree on deadlines. Walk back to desk. Reply to emails. Organize files. Print document. Pick up printout. Staple pages. File document. Shut down computer.

Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Get off bus. Walk home. Unlock door. Enter house. Close door. Lock door. Take off shoes. Put shoes on rack. Walk to living room.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and meat. Close refrigerator. Place vegetables and meat on counter. Open cabinet. Take out pot. Turn on stove. Place pot on stove. Add water to pot. Chop vegetables. Add vegetables to pot. Add meat to pot. Cook soup. Turn off stove. Pour soup into bowl. Place bowl on table. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Stand up.

Carry dishes to sink. Turn on tap. Rinse dishes. Place dishes in dishwasher. Close dishwasher. Turn on dishwasher. Pick up sponge. Wipe counter. Rinse sponge. Turn off tap. Throw trash in bin. Wipe table with cloth. Shake cloth. Fold cloth. Put cloth away. Turn off kitchen light. Walk to living room.

Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Browse channels. Choose movie. Watch TV. Pick up book. Open book. Read pages. Put down book. Pick up phone. Check messages. Reply to text. Put down phone. Pick up glass. Drink water. Put down glass. Turn off TV. Walk to bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Showering and getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Turn on shower. Step into shower. Wash body with soap. Shampoo hair. Rinse hair. Turn off shower. Step out of shower. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Put on pajamas. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off light. Walk to bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down, reading or using phone
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Sit on bed. Pick up phone. Check social media. Read article. Put down phone. Pick up book. Open book. Read pages. Turn off lamp. Lie down. Pull blanket over body.
Close eyes. Breathe deeply. Turn to left side. Bend knees. Place arm under pillow. Turn to back. Stretch arms. Remain still.
